title: Accidental Damage
description: Covers physical damage to the insured vehicle caused by a sudden, unintended collision or impact.
exclusions: Damage arising from routine wear and tear
Damage while driving without a valid licence

title: Theft of Vehicle
description: Covers total loss of the insured vehicle due to theft, subject to a valid police report (FIR).
exclusions: Theft not reported to police within 48 hours
Keys left in an unattended, unlocked vehicle

title: Third-Party Liability
description: Covers legal liability for injury or property damage caused to a third party in an accident involving the insured vehicle.
exclusions: Liability arising outside the policy's geographic coverage

title: Natural Calamity Damage
description: Covers damage caused by flood, storm, earthquake, or other natural calamities.
exclusions: Damage to vehicles parked in known flood-risk zones without prior warning heed

title: Fire Damage
description: Covers damage to the insured vehicle caused by fire, explosion, or self-ignition.
exclusions: Damage from fire caused by an illegal modification to the vehicle
